messages.content:

Answer on the first line with your answer only (a word, a short phrase or a lane number), then give one sentence saying why on the next line.

raw_output:
Lane 4
Person 2 is moving to their right (lane 2), so you should keep to your right as well by moving to lane 4 to pass safely.
